cluster.tooltip.bind_ip:
bind_ip. Slave server IP
The slave server's IPv4 address; the master server listens on and connects to this IP.
When master and slave servers are on the same computer, use 127.0.0.1 (localhost); otherwise use 0.0.0.0 (all IPs).
Only needs to be set on the master server.
cluster.tooltip.cluster_key: World verification password — used between servers when running multiple servers together
cluster.tooltip.cluster_name: Special characters like + | [] \ are now supported
cluster.tooltip.cluster_token:
Server token
The credential that keeps the server running independently; only a qualifying token can start the server. The player who created the token automatically becomes an admin of the server started with it
cluster.tooltip.console_enabled: Console cannot be used when disabled
cluster.tooltip.customization_mode: Only takes effect when 'Custom Mode' is selected
cluster.tooltip.game_mode:
Game style
Mainly four types: social, cooperative, competitive, and mad.
Shows this room's play tendency, whether friendly/social or combative. Does not affect game content.
cluster.tooltip.lan_only_cluster: If enabled, the server only allows players on the same LAN to join
cluster.tooltip.master_ip:
master_ip. Master server IP
The master server's IPv4 address; the slave server requests and connects to this IP.
When master and slave servers are on the same computer, use 127.0.0.1; otherwise use the master server's IP. Only needs to be set on the slave server
cluster.tooltip.master_port:
World communication port
The UDP port the master server listens on / the port the slave server requests to connect to the master server on.
Master and slave servers should use the same value
cluster.tooltip.max_players: The more players, the more load on the server
cluster.tooltip.max_snapshots:
Maximum number of snapshots the server retains
By default, the server saves the archive and generates a snapshot when a new day starts. The number of snapshots retained determines the maximum number of days you can roll back.
While players are present in the world, the server will not clean up that world's snapshots.
cluster.tooltip.offline_cluster: Creates an offline server. This server will not be shown in the public server list, only local users can join, and all Steam-related features are disabled
cluster.tooltip.pause_when_nobody: Auto-pauses when no one is in the world
cluster.tooltip.pvp: Whether to enable player vs. player
cluster.tooltip.shard_enabled: shard_enabled. Whether to use multi-world mode. In Don't Starve Together, each world represents an independent server process, so surface plus underground (two worlds total) is also a multi-server mode. In multi-world mode, based on your settings, one world is set as the master world and the others as slave worlds. Only disable this if you're sure you only need a single world.
cluster.tooltip.steam_group_admins:
Whether to make Steam group admins into game admins
When enabled, Steam group admins automatically get in-game admin status.
cluster.tooltip.steam_group_id:
Steam group ID
Every Steam group has a unique number associated with it; enter the group ID here to bind the Steam group.
Once bound, the server will be shown with priority in the lobby list for group members, marked with a red, yellow, or white flag icon.
cluster.tooltip.steam_group_only:
Whether to only allow Steam group members to join
When enabled, only group members can join; other players cannot.
cluster.tooltip.tick_rate:
Number of communications per second between client and server
When performance allows, a higher communication frequency makes the game smoother and the experience better, but greatly increases server load. The value should be divisible by 60, e.g. 15, 20, 30, 60, etc.
cluster.tooltip.vote_enabled: When enabled, players can vote to kick, roll back, or reset the world
cluster.tooltip.whitelist_slots:
Once set, this number of slots is reserved for whitelisted players only; other players share the remaining slots.
Regarding reserved slots and the whitelist: the actual reserved slots are not necessarily equal to the configured value, but whichever is smaller between the configured value and the number of IDs on the whitelist.
cluster.whitelist.tips: Players on the whitelist can use reserved slots, preventing overcrowding from blocking server entry

setting.dstConfig.persistent_storage_roo:
Sets the path of the game configuration directory. The path must be absolute.
    The full path to user files is
    <persistent_storage_root>/<conf_dir>/
    <conf_dir> is the value set via -conf_dir
    The default value depends on the platform:
        Windows: <your Documents folder>/Klei
        Mac OSX: <your home folder>/Documents/Klei
        Linux: ~/.klei

    -ugc_directory <path of the directory to store v2 mods in>
